Definition: properly, requital, i.e. a (voluntary) sacrifice in thanks
BiblicalUsage: The peace offering is the sacrifice of fellowship. The ark is brought in and they offer burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God, the law sets out the sacrifice of the peace offerings among the offerings, and the prince enters to prepare his peace offerings. Even the strange woman in Proverbs says, I have peace offerings with me; this day have I paid my vows.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the peace offering preaches communion. Burnt offerings go up wholly to God, but the peace offering is shared, and I hold that God invites His people to eat with Him.
